title: Social trade
tagline: We create a social token economy for communities in Colombia that use coca leaf as their trade ciurrency
description:
In Colombia in rural areas where coca leaf is grown, it is used as a trade currency as well. Our project aims to implement Gnosis Circles to change Coca Leaf for CRC tokens to trade between coca farmers and coffee farmers.
This project has a marketplace in which farmers could trade first necessity goods for a tokenized version of coca leaf to help them.
how_its_made:
We are using Dynamic for social wallet and account abstraction, we are using the CRC tokens of Gnosis and Blockscout.
Our goal was to use account abstraction to have a seamlessly experience for non crypto users.
We used ReactJS and the Circles SDK to create the marketplace. We also integrated blockscout as our block explorer
